provider.name: MWS Cloud Platform
provider.summary: Russian public cloud of MTS (MTS Web Services). Its tariff page bills a GPU virtual machine as separate lines - the graphics card, each vCPU and each gigabyte of memory - so the figure here is the card's line alone, and the processor and memory a machine needs are added on top. Prices are in roubles and include 22% VAT, as the table states; GPU machines are offered in the ru-central1 region only. The dollar figure uses the Bank of Russia's official rate of the day.
provider.notes: Static tariff page (docs); table Compute / Виртуальные машины; rows "Видеокарта (GPU) <card> в регионе <region>" only, gpu_only scope (vCPU and RAM for GPU VMs are separate lines); hourly column "₽/час с НДС 22%" (the monthly column is a 720-hour reference); RUB with VAT as printed; a row whose footnote or region start date is after today is skipped; NVIDIA A100 80GB = a100-80; instance = row label without the footnote mark; region = the row's own label (ru-central1)
